messages:
Alex: Canary rollout of kernel-selector v3.4 shows p99 spike on llm-13b (hosted). Anyone else see this?

Priya: Seeing it in metrics. p50 ~85ms unchanged, p99 jumping from 78ms -> 320ms after commit abc123 :grimacing:

Alex: Quick dump from canary node:
```
model: llama-3-13b
kernel_selector: v3.4
rope_theta: 10000
head_dim: 128
kv_cache_stride: 1
fallback_reason: kernel-mismatch -> slowpath
p99: 320ms
```

Mateo: Interesting — kernel-selector started preferring tile-aligned kernels for head_dim=160; if model has 128 we miss optimized path. Did the selector mapping change recently?

Li: I pushed a change earlier to prefer 8x head tiling, yes. It assumed head_dim multiples. For Llama3-13b we have 128 heads -> head_dim 128, so mismatch.

Priya: Could rope_theta change cause stride differences that invalidated cached kernels? I remember RoPE scaling touching kv cache layout.

Alex: Possible. Repro steps: force kernel to 'optimized' vs 'slowpath'
```
curl -X POST /infer -d '{"model":"llama-3-13b","opts":{"force_kernel":"optimized","seq_len":1024}}'
```
When forced to optimized p99 drops back to ~90ms.

Mateo: Can you attach a perf trace? I can look at kernel selection decision logs.

Alex: Attached minimal trace snippet:
```
[selector] commit=abc123 choose=tile8 head_dim=128 -> not found -> fallback slowpath
[exec] slowpath_matmul 72%
[exec] kv_cache_mismatch 18%
```

Li: Ok reverting the selector mapping for canary and adding a guard: only prefer tile8 when head_dim % 160 == 0 or model.profile indicates compatibility.

Priya: Also add a test in runtime-smoke that runs chat-template sequences with long prefixes (system + convo) to catch kv cache stride regressions.

Alex: Filed RG-4321. Revert in progress, canary paused. Thanks :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Canary rollback triggered for stack llm-runtime/canary by Li at 1999004380 :rocket:

Mateo: Follow-up: let's add a sparse fallback metric and alert when slowpath > 5% of requests for a model.

Alex: Agreed. I'll own instrumentation.
